The quotient J_(H R H^-1)(H(y))=J_H(Ry)/J_H(y) gives exactly the prescribed support and jumps. Integer compositions of sizes 2..q yield \(2K\le n\le qK\), even counts for q=2, all >=2 for q>=3. Script checks 641 distinct finite rational cyclic identities; no infinite conclusion is inferred from finite testing.

value.rationale: The 2025 necessary jump-cancellation theorem leaves a motivated inverse design question: can every abstract compatible jump configuration on periodic break orbits occur? The all-parameter answer is yes, including arbitrary distinct orbits, arbitrary positive nonunit jump ratios with orbitwise product one, all K, and exact cardinality interval \(2K\le n\le qK\). It rules out hidden obstructions and gives a sharp parity-only global restriction for order-two dynamics versus full break-count freedom for higher orders. This is a natural complete structural classification, not an arbitrary finite cutoff or rephrased fixed example.
